variants.headline: Home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has punished the colony. The action establishes a punitive development in the relationship, not the particular effects of that action. Scrutiny of {target} should address the use of authority without adding an unreported restriction, financial loss or change in supplies to the account.

Workers should not disappear from the discussion when authorities exchange claims about punishment. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A sanction enters the colonial relationship
variants.sub: The colony is the subject of punitive action by the home world.
variants.body:
Punishment is a claim that authority may impose a consequence on others. The home world has exercised that claim against {colony}. In considering {target}, readers should be able to examine fairness and responsibility without being asked to accept an invented explanation of the dispute.

Workers should not disappear from the discussion when authorities exchange claims about punishment. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Authority takes a punitive turn
variants.sub: The home world has punished the colony.
variants.body:
A punitive action by the home world now forms part of the colony's affairs. The report establishes that punishment occurred, while leaving its particulars unstated. Any assessment of {target} should therefore distinguish the political judgment of the action from assertions about consequences not supplied here.

Workers should not disappear from the discussion when authorities exchange claims about punishment. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
